what.text: This page follows refugees from Mauritania in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 43906 refugees from Mauritania.
Senegal hosts the largest share, 37.9%, followed by Mali, France and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mauritania with AQIM in 2010.
The fact pack records no other conflict and no dated events, so it does not say why people left.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1989 at 48236 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 84310, at the end of 1995, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1989 to 1998, 2008 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
